concerns.text: FR-001 cites a Zenodo DOI placeholder (``) for the IL‑Benchmark dataset. Without a concrete, accessible source of CCSD(T)/CBS reference interaction energies and XYZ coordinates, the primary validation target is undefined, making the benchmark and all downstream error analyses impossible. This violates the requirement that the benchmark be directly retrieved (Constitution Principle VI) and renders the validation circular/absent.

FR-008 specifies a NIST API endpoint placeholder (" No address associated with hostname)")] for experimental bulk‑property data. The absence of a real endpoint means the correlation analysis (US‑3) has no independent ground‑truth bulk properties, undermining the exploratory validation of D3 relevance to density/viscosity. The study cannot fulfill its claimed correlation objectives without real data.
